text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Mejiro Dober! Mejiro Dober is<n>the winner
today!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
A new queen has conquered the turf<n>of Yodo, and
her name is Mejiro<n>Dooober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I, Mejiro Dober, beat Air Groove...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dober.

Your performance was exemplary.<n>You have bested
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, I...
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You've always been a shining and<n>brilliant light
before me, and it's<n>because of you that I was able
to run<n>here today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that... I will never forget this<n>race!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your challenge to me reaffirmed that I<n>am also
walking down the right path.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For revealing that fact to me, I would<n>like to give
you my thanks. From now<n>on...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I shall be the one issuing challenges<n>to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let's race again. I hope we'll be able<n>to compete
on even bigger stages<n>someday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-yes! Of course!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone's waiting for<n>you. You
shouldn't keep them in<n>suspense for too long.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your support,<n>everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This is just the beginning! I'm going<n>to keep
reaching for greater heights<n>and shine even
brighter!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to watch over me and<n>remember
my name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I am the queen who conquered Yodo...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And the one who earned this<n>spectacular crown for
the prestigious<n>Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bursting into full bloom and shining<n>with a new light
at the dawn of<n>another Mejiro era is none other
than<n>I, Mejiro Dober!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The cheers for Mejiro Dober seem to<n>echo on and
on for ages.
Then, one day...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, a special feature on the<n>legacies of the
Mejiro family! Our first<n>spotlight is on none other
than the<n>winner of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober! Wow! Talk about a<n>fantastic
performance!

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
I completely agree. That speed and<n>grace of hers
makes her the perfect<n>light to usher in a new era of
Mejiro<n>racers!

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
Dober is incredible, but we can't<n>forget Mejiro
Bright! Her<n>performance at the spring Tenno Sho
was...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. ♪ Looks like we've made a<n>bit of progress,
haven't we, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but this is just the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Our legacies... and this new era of the<n>Mejiro family
is only just beginning!
